preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The number of strings N and the length of each string must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == N for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each binary string must have a length equal to N.
All characters in the binary strings must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must contain T lines, each with a binary string of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == N for s in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output binary string must have a length of N.

postconditions.expression: all(any(s[i] != strings[j][i] for i in range(N)) for j in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each output binary string must differ from all given strings in at least one position.
